notes: «- قال أبو بكر حدثنا حاتم بن إسماعيل المدني -» is an editor gloss: left out, so «حاتم» is written once (occurrence 1)
The father «أبيه» is named only in the scene, by his own words («فقلت أنا محمد بن علي بن حسين»): taken as the name, as rule 8 takes a name the text gives later; a reviewer should check this reading
Jabir answers and speaks in the saying, so he is the last link (rule 6)
